sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९६ ।।
transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaṇṇavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 96 ।।

translations.english: A meteor had fallen from the sky resembling thunder, coupled with inauspicious eagle cries.
